about: Scenes and frames of the App Store screenshots. Units are CSS px of the 2x sources (1 CSS px = 2 image px = 1 pt on a Retina screen). A scene's crop is the card the frame shows, in its window; its lens is in card coordinates; keep boxes (the formulas a paper frame claims stay as written) are in lens coordinates. A live frame's scenes are the moments of one lens over one page, in time order: the same page, window, crop and lens, history one message apart (compose.py live_steps refuses anything else). A retired scene is one no frame shows any more; its renders stay in renders/ as the record of why. render.sh reads scenes and renders; compose.py reads everything.

chat-ja.retired: 2026-10-19 vision verdict: the lens holds the whole log, so no original shows above it (reads as a native chat); en has 草 as "Grass."

chat-live5.note: the live hero's moments (chat-live5, 6, 7): with five to seven messages the log does not fill the window yet, so it does not scroll and every message stays where it landed; the lens sits where the new ones land and fills up as rin's question, Maya's answer and rin's reply arrive, and the messages above it stay the same original in all three. Chosen in scratch trial renders over states of a full, scrolling log: a fixed lens edge then cuts a different message at each moment unless the new messages have the same heights as the ones they push out, and the only such run at a 420 pt column (history 14 to 16) puts Ollie's wrapped line into the lens, where the reader split its 3-character tail into its own line (イだわ as Idawa, 이다야). The card is the 420 x 688 pt column cut 122 pt lower (crop y 180 to 302, the lens 334 to 212 in the card; the lens in the window is where it was, so the lens pictures and renders are unchanged): 566 pt is the tallest cut the frame's coverage floor allows (3 x 420 x 566 = 55.03 % of 1440 x 900), the cut falls in the empty rows between junpark's reactions and Ollie's reply (card rows 110 to 132 pt are background), and the unchanged top of the card is then 212 of 566 pt (37 %) instead of 334 of 688 (49 %)

paper.retired: 2026-10-19 vision verdict: the paragraphs with inline mathematics come out flattened (20 s-1, T(1 - 2-1/3)) and at jumping sizes

paper-p2.note: rendered 9 times (the rerun lines in RUN.txt that name paper-p2): once with a crop 92 pt higher, whose top edge cut a line of the left column, once with the lens 6 pt lower, where the OCR split the section number off the heading, then 7 times with this lens, because on the same input Apple Translation returns the identifiers TranslationFilter and CodeRegion in varying case (trAnslationFilter, TrAnslationFilter, translationFilter, Coderegion); the frame uses the first run that returned both unchanged (the last line)
